propositions: Failed identity writes (add_label, set_entity_property) trigger deletion of successfully-created Jira issues, destroying recoverable work
Keyed-pending bindings persist pointing to deleted issue keys after rollback, causing recover_pending to permanently retry against dead keys and strand tickets
Recovery machinery (recover_pending keyed branch) already exists to retro-attach labels and properties deterministically without search, making the delete redundant

Jira rejects field writes with misleading screen-not-found messages in three distinct situations: field not on screen, jira.permission.createclone.denied workflow property set, or malformed field value

The rollback deletion must be removed and binding left keyed-pending to enable recovery; the solution requires declaring Create/Edit screen requirement for labels rather than pre-flight field discovery
